name: CUI-Block-Marked-Documents
description: Inline Web DLP: block uploads carrying high-precision CUI markings (banners, category tokens, legacy FOUO/LES/SBU, distribution statements) via CUI-Detect-Block-Grade. Ships DISABLED at INFO; enable after reviewing monitor incidents from CUI-Monitor-All.

name: CUI-Caution-Weak-Markings
description: Inline Web DLP: caution (user must confirm) on lower-precision CUI signals: bare CUI, standalone LDCs, malformed markings, designation blocks, via CUI-Detect-Caution-Grade. Never BLOCK on these.

name: CUI-Monitor-All
description: Inline Web DLP: monitor-only rule over the full CUI-Detect-All surface. Enable this first to size incident volume and tune before enabling the block and caution rules above it.

name: CUI-SSL-Decrypt-File-Share-Webmail-AI
description: SSL Inspection: decrypt file-sharing, webmail and AI/ML applications so CUI markings inside HTTPS uploads can be inspected.

name: CUI-CAC-AI-No-Upload
description: Cloud App Control: on AI & ML applications allow browsing but block upload and file submission, so marked documents cannot be pasted into public models regardless of content inspection.

name: CUI-Email-Monitor
description: Outbound Email DLP: monitor mail leaving onboarded Microsoft 365 / Gmail tenants for CUI markings (full CUI-Detect-All surface). Monitor-only; switch the block-grade engine to BLOCK after tuning.
